content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary output anomaly detected for model 'rwd-llm-v2b' in us-west-2. 9/12 canary runs returned garbled tokens (non-UTF8 output). Error rate 11.8% over last 3m. Trigger: deploy pipeline 3478910000 -> artifacts/weights-20260317-2b-shard.tar

sre-oncall: i'm on it, grabbing context. alice-nguyen, did you push the rollout?

alice-nguyen: yep, started canary rollout 3478910000 ~2m ago. artifacts pointing to weightset s-20260317-2b. tokenizer config stayed at release/20260228 (didn't update).

ben_cho: that mismatch would do it — weights expect vocab_v4, tokenizer at vocab_v3. Confirming now.

mike-eng: customer-impact: monitoring shows ~3% of live traffic hitting canary hosts, errors bubbled to 0.9% overall but some customers in A/B groups see gibberish generations; CSM reported 2 customers complaining. cc @carla

carla: noted. let's minimize exposure. sre-oncall — recommend kill-switch and rollback. :warning:

sre-oncall: agreed. flipping feature flag route:production.model.routing.disable_canary=true -> toggle via console.

sre-oncall: /deploy-tool flag set production.model.routing.disable_canary true

ops-runner: executed: FLAG_SET OK (txid=0x9f3). Observability: canary requests dropping to 0.

alice-nguyen: initiating rollback to weightset s-20260228-2b (previous stable). starting warm-up

ben_cho: also pushing tokenizer config patch to release/20260317-vocab_v4 with quick hotpatch, will stage but do not cut until rollback validated.

sre-oncall: can we keep canary nodes pinned for postmortem? don't purge caches yet (we need traces + KV cache snapshots).

ops-runner: pinned canary hosts: rwd-canary-17..20. KV snapshot saved to s3://redwood-ops/canary-dumps/3478912385.tar.gz

mike-eng: customer comms: recommend short message to affected CSMs saying 'we rolled back a canary; investigating; no broader impact expected'. Carla to draft?

carla: on it. will send to CSMs and update incident channel in 15m.

sre-oncall: final state: kill-switch ON, rollback in progress, canary traffic 0, rollback completed on 3478912367. tagging for postmortem.

alice-nguyen: rollback success -> serving weightset s-20260228-2b. will open PR to add tokenizers sync check to deploy pipeline.

ben_cho: adding preflight check: compare tokenizer.vocab.hash vs weightset.metadata.vocab_hash, fail deploy if mismatch.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: sev=3, impacted_customers=2, mitigation=rollback+flag, timeline_saved=/incidents/3478912385/timeline.json

sre-oncall: closing short; will hand to eng-ml for postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
